scenarios.scenario: Switch between a drawing and a part being edited

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` and `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` are open
the user edits Sketch1 in the part, activates the drawing and collapses its drawing resources branch
the user selects the part document tab
the part sketch viewport and model browser are displayed
the sketch ribbon is active
the user selects the drawing document tab
the drawing sheet and drawing browser are displayed
the drawing ribbon is active
the drawing resources branch is collapsed
the part remains available as an open tab
the user selects the part document tab again
the part sketch viewport and model browser are displayed
the sketch editing environment remains active

scenarios.scenario: Activate a document from the tab-strip window list

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` are open
the part is active
document tabs are visible
the user opens the document list at the end of the tab strip
the list contains the open part and drawing
the active part is marked in the list
the menu offers Arrange, Horizontal Tile, Vertical Tile and Restore All
the menu offers separate Close Tabs and Close All items
the user selects the drawing from the list
the drawing becomes active
its sheet and drawing browser are displayed
the part remains open

`fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd`, `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd`, `fixtures/cad/revolve/revolve-profile.opd` and `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` are open in that order
the drawing is active and its tab is visible
the user drags the drawing tab left across several neighboring tabs
the drawing tab appears at its new position among the document tabs
the drawing remains active
its sheet and browser remain displayed
the user drags the drawing tab back to its earlier position
the drawing tab returns to its earlier position
the drawing remains active

`fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd`, `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd`, `fixtures/cad/revolve/revolve-profile.opd` and `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` are open in that order
the drawing is active
an inactive part tab is visible
the user drags the inactive part tab left across several neighboring tabs
the part tab appears at its new position among the document tabs
the part becomes active
the part viewport and model browser are displayed
the drawing remains open

scenarios.scenario: Detach an active drawing from the tab strip

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd`, `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` and `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` are open
the drawing is active in the main document tab strip
the user drags the drawing tab from the strip into the workspace
the drawing is displayed in a separate window with its own document tab
the drawing sheet remains visible in that window
the part remains open in the main workspace
the user selects another open part tab in the main workspace
that part becomes active in the main workspace
the drawing remains open in its separate window

scenarios.scenario: Inspect the detached drawing tab context menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open
the user drags its tab into the workspace to detach it into a separate window
the drawing has a document tab in that window
the user opens the detached drawing tab context menu
the menu offers Close, Close Tabs, Close All, Save and Properties
it displays shortcuts for Close and Save
the user dismisses the menu
the drawing remains open in its separate window

scenarios.scenario: Switch shared controls between a detached drawing and a part

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` are open
the user drags the drawing tab into the workspace to detach it into a separate window
the part context is active in the main workspace
the user clicks the detached drawing sheet
the main application browser displays the drawing tree
the main application ribbon displays drawing-context tabs
the user selects the part tab in the main workspace
the main application browser displays the part tree
the main application ribbon displays part-context tabs
the detached drawing remains open

scenarios.scenario: Switch backward and forward between neighboring part tabs

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` are open as adjacent tabs in that order
the part on the right is active
the user presses Control+Shift+Tab
the part on the left becomes active
its viewport and model browser are displayed
the user presses Control+Tab
the part on the right becomes active again
its viewport and model browser are displayed
